fusions.name: Knives from Cover
fusions.desc: Looses 3 knives from behind your shield, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage.

fusions.name: Counterstab
fusions.desc: Stabs past the edge of your shield, dealing 28 damage as a critical hit and leaving the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Hidden Edges
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 25% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and blades behind your shield leave them [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Finishing Edge
fusions.desc: You deal 12% more damage to enemies below half health. Your armour is 5% higher.
